lore: Shed by the Dragonmites that crawl out of the bedrock fountain once the dragon is badly hurt. The plates are warm, as if the dragon's breath still sat in them.
use: Dragonmites call no wave before the dragon falls to half health; then a new wave comes every 30 seconds near the exit portal. A mite killed by a player drops up to one piece, Looting adds more.
For now it is a material. Recipes that use it will follow.
secret: The more players stand on the island, the more mites answer the dragon: one more per wave for every two further fighters, at most 16 alive at once.

lore: An egg that should not exist: Dragonmites hatch only from the dragon's call.
use: Spawns a Dragonmite that is bound to no dragon and stays like any other monster. It appears in the creative tab only when the server config allows it (exposeSpawnEgg).
secret: Mites called by the dragon vanish in smoke, without drops, as soon as their dragon dies.

lore: A scorched page from the last fight at the edge of the End.
use: The Simple End Dragon Fight Guide explains scaling, the faster dragon, summonings, the entry animation and dragonmites. Craft it shapeless from a book and an ender pearl.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.
